g.text: Kept 91 sessions that Claude Code has since deleted
Claude Code deletes its own copies after 30 days.
looked things up 27 times in the last 7 days
why did we pick session cookies over JWT?
“We need instant revocation, so server-side sessions;
JWT would mean a denylist anyway.”
You decided this in ChatGPT on March 4: removed users must lose
access at once, and JWTs would have needed a denylist anyway.
